description: Held-out routing questions: engineering, physics and mathematics, written alongside benchmark.json and never used to tune the router. Same label policy as benchmark.json.

cases.q: Why do the blades of a wind turbine twist along their length?
Which aluminium alloy offers the highest strength-to-weight ratio for aircraft wing skins?
How thick must the wall of a 1 m diameter steel pipe be to hold 40 bar with a design stress of 150 MPa?
Summarize the LIGO detection of GW150914 and the measured masses of the two black holes.
Find the Laplace transform of t^2 e^{-3t}.
Integrate the Van der Pol oscillator with mu = 5 from x = 2, x' = 0 and plot the limit cycle.
What causes cavitation damage on ship propellers and how can it be reduced?
Fit a Weibull distribution to the failure times in the attached spreadsheet and report the shape parameter.
What minimum approach distance does NFPA 70E specify for energised 480 V equipment?
Prove that every group of prime order is cyclic.
Do variable-speed drives actually save energy on centrifugal fans compared with inlet guide vanes, or is that overstated?
Hypothesize why the measured thermal conductivity of our graphene films drops sharply above 400 K.
What could be causing the excess low-frequency noise in our superconducting qubits? Suggest candidate mechanisms.
Is it really true that cold-formed steel framing performs worse than timber in a fire?
Should engineers rely on linear elastic analysis for the seismic design of reinforced concrete frames?
Does the Mpemba effect actually exist, given the conflicting experimental reports?
Evaluate thorium molten-salt reactors as a design option for baseload power generation.
Give an overview of everything known about defects in metal additive manufacturing, how they are detected and how they affect fatigue.
Assess magnesium alloys as a lightweight structural material for car bodies.
Investigate the landscape of machine-learned interatomic potentials for alloy design.
Explore links between percolation theory, forest-fire models and cascading failures in power grids.
Brainstorm connections between knot theory, polymer entanglement and vortex reconnection in fluids.
Map out how ergodic theory, statistical mechanics and the foundations of thermodynamics are linked.
Explore connections between boiler water chemistry and tube ruptures in power plants.
